items.summary: Recommendation: preserve containment-only execution. Retain the three evidence-backed opportunities—deeppenetrations.com liquid-wrench CTR, broadwayshowgirls.com Priya Raghunathan CTR, and americastrikes.com mobile performance—as deferred backlog. Reject new change requests, requeues, experiments, telemetry, dependencies, spend, monetization expansion, and unsupported revenue claims because 47 failure follow-ups remain open, 28 improvements await measurement, and only 2 outcomes are proven in the 30-day scorecard. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: $4.92 aggregate commission and $0 site-attributed; ROI, margin, and causal lift are unknown. Smallest next step: complete existing repair-or-close, measurement reconciliation, and legal/security evidence. Owner decision: authorize the prepared Woot permission request after counsel review, or keep it unsent.

Handoff: the CRO candidate plan is preserved as deferred prioritization evidence, not execution authorization. The proposed SEO and performance changes are safe in principle but blocked this cycle by unresolved failure, validation, rollback, deduplication, and measurement gates. Do not create duplicate proposals or change requests.

Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and external outreach unsent. Official Woot materials establish API access mechanics but not public or commercial reuse rights; all four launch-readiness tasks remain open, and security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates are incomplete. The smallest next step is the existing consolidated evidence bundle and counsel review; no public exposure, alert expansion, or rights-dependent monetization is authorized.
